Value: Compute flow accumulation from G13 Flow Direction. Each cell value = count of upstream cells draining into that cell (or upstream area in square metres/km² if weighted). Unit: number of upstream cells OR upstream area in km² (document which). High accumulation values mark drainage channels. Used for drainage concentration analysis and stream network extraction.

Flow accumulation values range from 0 (ridgeline cells with no upstream area) to very large numbers (major river outlets — potentially millions of cells for Niger/Benue). Values typically log-transformed for visualisation and hazard index use. Document whether output is in cells or area units (km²). This layer is a key input to G24 flood hazard modelling.
